title: The Weighted Sphere
logline: A destitute zero-g billiards hustler uses a magnetized cue ball to beat an orbital bookmaker's collection agent.

roles.description: A veteran zero-g billiards hustler whose arthritic fingers rely on hidden electromagnetic cheat rings.
Enforces betting lines behind the freight berths; calm, polite, and tracks debts down to the last decimal.
A retired docker who certifies table grav-dampeners and takes quiet pride in half a century of honest wagers.
A cavernous decommissioned cargo sphere converted into a tiered zero-gravity kinetic sport hall.

public_situation: Dockers pack the observation gantries in {system} as an aging billiards champion plays a high-stakes match to clear personal debts.
private_truth: The hustler secretly weighted the cue ball with high-density silicate cores to curve rebounds across the zero-gravity table.

beats.public_change: The bookie's enforcers post sentries around the billiards bay to ensure the match goes forward.

missions.reason: The hustler needs dense refined silicate ore delivered to cast magnetic counterbalance weights before table inspection.
missions.private_fact: The hustler already lost two fingers to the bookie's collectors and cannot survive another beating.

beats.public_change: The umpire demands a certified inspection of all game spheres before opening wagers.

missions.reason: The hustler asks the pilot to collect the concealed magnetic ring from a pawn broker's security locker.
missions.private_fact: The pawn broker tipped off the bookie that the hustler bought specialized electromagnetic coils.

beats.public_change: Spectators crowd the viewing gallery as the final frame begins under heavy betting action.

missions.reason: The umpire asks the pilot to scan the table's grav-dampener field to verify there is no outside interference with the balls.
missions.private_fact: The bookie has secretly installed a magnetic bias plate under the corner pocket to force a scratch.

player_choice.prompt: The scan reveals that both sides cheated: the hustler uses a magnetic cue ball, while the bookie wired the pocket. The umpire demands an immediate ruling.

options.label: Present evidence of the bookie's wired pocket to wipe the hustler's debt clean
Expose both frauds and let the umpire seize all wagered stakes for the dockers' relief fund
Conceal the bookie's cheating in exchange for a hefty cut of table profits

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot exposes the bookie's pocket bias plate.
resolutions.summary: {role:hall_umpire} cancels {role:old_hustler}'s debt and bans {role:dockside_bookie} from the hall, while dockers celebrate the hustler's victory.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved the house bookie was rigging the zero-gravity pool table.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot exposes both players for table fraud.
resolutions.summary: {role:hall_umpire} seizes all wagered funds for the station relief chest, barring both {role:old_hustler} and {role:dockside_bookie} from the berths.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot covers for the bookie in exchange for credits.
resolutions.summary: {role:dockside_bookie} collects on the fixed match and forecloses on {role:old_hustler}, while the pilot receives a quiet transfer.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot exposes only the hustler's cue ball.
resolutions.summary: The crowd turns on {role:old_hustler} for using magnetic weights; {role:dockside_bookie} seizes the hustler's ship for back debts.

resolutions.reached_by: The deliveries fail or the pilot drops the contract.
resolutions.summary: The match proceeds on the rigged table; {role:old_hustler} scratches on the final ball and loses everything to {role:dockside_bookie}.

loose_threads.detail: The silicate sphere's internal induction coil matches micro-actuators salvaged from industrial cargo crane solenoids.
A dockside credit ledger shows the bookie bought up third-party medical debts belonging to the hustler's family.

radio_hooks: Zero-gravity billiards championship draws record wagers across {system} cargo ring.
Dockside bookmakers offer five-to-one odds against veteran hustler clearing slate.
Station inspectors announce sudden integrity sweeps on kinetic game spheres.

voice_direction.old_hustler: Raspy, weary, speaking in dry cynical metaphors and masking panic with practiced saloon bravado.
voice_direction.dockside_bookie: Soft-spoken, polite, speaking with the chilling patience of an accountant reviewing delinquent balances.
voice_direction.hall_umpire: Stern, formal, enunciating rules with liturgical reverence for dockside tradition.
